scope: R01 provider-side read-only mapping of ten selected KIS official REST operations. Portal response schemas were reviewed alongside pinned official sample code at one immutable commit. This is documentation mapping, not a live API validation or a data-rights grant.
evidence_level: official_portal_response_schema_reviewed; pinned_sample_code_crosschecked; no live response observed

count_scope.147_field_registry: provider/data-contract registry denominator; registry source is MCP-owned and updated only for fields bound by reviewed portal evidence

r01_chart_contract.status: unchanged; consumer completion classifications, not raw provider-key availability

count_scope.dart_scope_note: The three DART names are raw response key/path checks in OpenDART filing-list guide; they are not KIS mappings and do not count as completed R01 consumer fields. Canonical filing semantics and live response remain separate.
count_scope.previous_dart_raw_keys_verified_scope: official OpenDART filing-list guide; key/path existence only; canonical R01 statuses unchanged

schema_rules: KIS portal raw response type String and maximum length are copied literally; numeric parsing is a later schema-validated transform and must not use binary floating point for money.
Provider key/path confirmation is distinct from canonical consumer field confirmation. A key can be documented while canonical unit, currency, time, series type, rights or asset scope remain pending.
Date-only fields remain LocalDate; they are not converted to midnight UTC. received_at is generated locally only when the runtime observes the response and is not a provider as-of time.
No unknown provider units, currency, time zone, multiplier, contract month, period alignment, pagination behavior or finality is inferred.

The pinned official sample proves endpoint/TR identity and demonstrates body handling; where its behavior conflicts with the portal specification, the conflict is recorded and multi-page collection is blocked pending authoritative resolution.
